title: Endy · Pep-talk #2 — Slow still gets you there
hook: It is okay if today was slow.
scene: Endy alone in six cosy moments on EndScroll chapter-map backgrounds (slow walk on a morning path, flag, nap under a tree, tea at dusk, fireflies, back on the path to loop); own soft voice-over, one line per moment; no phone.
hypothesis: With character, montage structure, voice-over form and length held to goose_keep_going, our own words and sound keep at least half of its Instagram share and save rate (shares >= 0.8%, saves >= 0.7%).

title: Endy & Shelly · I Took A Nap (remake @sadgoose42)
hook: I had a lot of things to do today,
scene: Cosy living room, one locked front-on shot: Endy holds a tall stack of to-do papers; on "I took a nap" the papers burst and he sleeps inside his shell; Shelly drapes a blanket over him on the last word.
hypothesis: A 10-second single-shot remake of a 1.4M-view trending-song short, with our turtles, keeps at least half of Keep going's Instagram share and save rate (shares >= 0.8%, saves >= 0.7%).

title: Endy · A list of things that make me happy (remake @calmlings)
